s.d: συν-ελαύνω [in LXX: 2Ma.4:26 2Mac 4:42 2Mac 5:5 * ;] to drive together, force together: εἰς εἰρήνην, [[acts 7 26|Act.7:26]], Rec. (WH, RV, συνήλλασσεν).† (AS)
συν-επι-μαρτυρέω, -ῶ to join in attesting, bear witness together with: [[hebrews 2 4|Heb.2:4]] (Arist., Polyb., a1.).† (AS)
συν-έπομαι [in LXX: 2Ma.15:2, 3Ma.5:48 R 3Ma.6:21 * ;] to follow with, accompany: with dative of person(s), [[acts 20 4|Act.20:4.]]† (AS)

συνεργέω, -ῶ [in LXX: I [[esther 7 2|Est.7:2]], 1Ma.12:1 * ;] 1. prop., to work together (with): absol., [[mark 16 20|Mrk.16:20]], [[1-corinthians 16 16|1Co.16:16]], [[2-corinthians 6 1|2Co.6:1]]; with dative, [[james 2 22|Jas.2:22;]] dative commod., [[romans 8 28|Rom.8:28]], T, R, txt. (but see infr.). 2. In Hellenistic writers (M, Pr., 65), trans., to cause to work together (cf. ICC, in l): with accusative of thing(s), [[romans 8 28|Rom.8:28]] [WH] R, mg. (but see supr.).† (AS)

συνεργός, -όν [in LXX: 2Ma.8:7 Mac 14:5 * ;] a fellow-worker: with genitive of person(s), [[romans 16 3|Rom.16:3, 9 16:21]], [[philippians 2 25|Php.2:25 4:3]], [[1-thessalonians 3 2|1Th.3:2]], Rec., Phm 1 24; θεοῦ (cf. Lft., Notes, 41, 188), [[1-corinthians 3 9|1Co.3:9]] (pl.), [[1-thessalonians 3 2|1Th.3:2]] [WH] R, mg. (R, txt., διάκονον τοῦ θ.; on the original reading, see ICC, in l); τ. χαρᾶς ὑηῶν, [[2-corinthians 1 24|2Co.1:24;]] τ. ἀληθείᾳ, III Jn 8; before εἰς, [[2-corinthians 8 23|2Co.8:23]], [[colossians 4 11|Col.4:11]].† (AS)

συν-έρχομαι [in LXX for הָלַךְ, בּוֹא, אָסַף ni., etc. ;] 1. (cl.) to come together, assemble: [[mark 3 20|Mrk.3:20 14:53]], T, WH, txt., [[acts 1 6|Act.1:6 2:6 10:27 16:13 19:32 21:22 22:30 28:17]], [[1-corinthians 14 26|1Co.14:26]]; before εἰς, with accusative loc., [[acts 5 16|Act.5:16;]] ἐπὶ τ. αὐτό, [[1-corinthians 11 20|1Co.11:20 14:23]]; with dative of person(s), [[mark 14 53|Mrk.14:53]], WH, mg., R (πρὸς αὐτόν, see Field, Notes, 40), [[john 11 33|Jhn.11:33;]] ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ, [[1-corinthians 11 18|1Co.11:18;]] ἐνθάδε, [[acts 25 17|Act.25:17;]] [[mark 6 33|Mrk.6:33]], WH, mg. (cf. WH, Intr., 95 ff.); ὅπου, [[john 18 20|Jhn.18:20;]] with inf., [[luke 5 15|Luk.5:15;]] εἰς τ. φαγεῖν, [[1-corinthians 11 33|1Co.11:33;]] εἰς τ. ἧσσον, [[1-corinthians 11 17|1Co.11:17 11:34]]; of sexual intercourse (Xen., al.; γυναικί or absol.), [[matthew 1 18|Mat.1:18.]] 2. In later sense (see exx. in Milligan, Selections, 64, 105), to accompany: with dative of person(s), [[luke 23 55|Luk.23:55]], [[acts 1 21|Act.1:21 9:39 10:23, 45 11:12]]; before σύν, [[acts 21 16|Act.21:16;]] εἰς, [[acts 15 38|Act.15:38.]]† (AS)

συν-εσθίω [in LXX: [[genesis 43 32|Gen.43:32]], [[exodus 18 12|Exo.18:12]] (אָכַל), [[2-kings 12 17|4Ki.12:17]] (בָּרָה), [[psalms 101 5|Psa.101:5]] * ;] to eat with one: with dative of person(s), [[luke 15 2|Luk.15:2]], [[acts 10 41|Act.10:41 11:3]], [[1-corinthians 5 11|1Co.5:11]]; before μετά, with genitive of person(s), [[galatians 2 12|Gal.2:12.]]† (AS)

σύνεσις, -εως, ἡ (συνίημι), [in LXX for בִּינָה and cogn. forms, מַשְׂכִּית, דַּעַת, חׇכְמָה, etc. ;] 1. a running or flowing together (Hom.). 2. (a) understanding: [[luke 2 47|Luk.2:47]], [[1-corinthians 1 19|1Co.1:19]]" (LXX), [[ephesians 3 4|Eph.3:4]], [[colossians 1 9|Col.1:9 2:2]], [[2-timothy 2 7|2Ti.2:7]] (b) the understanding, the mind or intelligence: [[mark 12 33|Mrk.12:33.]]† SYN.: see: σοφία (AS)

συνετός, ή, -όν (συνίημι), [in LXX for בִּין, חָכָם, etc. ;] intelligent, sagacious, understanding: [[matthew 11 25|Mat.11:25]], [[luke 10 21|Luk.10:21]], [[acts 13 7|Act.13:7]], [[1-corinthians 1 19|1Co.1:19]]" (LXX) .† (AS)

συν-ευ-δοκέω, -ῶ [in LXX: 1Ma.1:57, 1Ma.4:28 א1, 2Ma.11:24 2Mac 11:35 * ;] to join in approving, consent, agree to or with: absol., [[acts 22 20|Act.22:20;]] with dative of person(s), [[romans 1 32|Rom.1:32;]] with dative of thing(s), [[luke 11 48|Luk.11:48]], [[acts 8 1|Act.8:1]]; with inf., [[1-corinthians 7 12|1Co.7:12-13]] (chiefly in late writers).† (AS)
συν-ευωχέω, -ῶ to entertain together. Pass., to fare sumptuously or feast together or with: Ju 12; with dative of person(s), [[2-peter 2 13|2Pe.2:13]] (Arist., Luc., al.).† (AS)
συν-εφ-ίστημι to place over. Pass., 1. to stand over (Thuc.). 2. to rise together: before κατά, with genitive of person(s) (against), [[acts 16 22|Act.16:22.]]† (AS)

συν-έχω [in LXX for עָצָר, חָבַר, etc. ;] 1. to hold together (τ. συνέχον τ. πάντα, Wis.1:7): of closing the ears, [[acts 7 57|Act.7:57]] (τ. στόμα, [[isaiah 52 15|Isa.52:15]]); to hem in, press on every side: [[luke 8 45|Luk.8:45 19:43]]. 2. to hold fast; (a) of a prisoner, to hold in charge (Luc.; cf. exx. in Deiss., BS, 160; MM, xxiv): [[luke 22 63|Luk.22:63;]] (b) to constrain: [[2-corinthians 5 14|2Co.5:14;]] pass., [[luke 12 50|Luk.12:50]], [[acts 18 5|Act.18:5]] (τ. λόγῳ; cf. Field, Notes, 128), [[philippians 1 23|Php.1:23;]] in pass., of ills, to be seized or afflicted by, suffering from: [[matthew 4 24|Mat.4:24]], [[luke 4 38|Luk.4:38 8:37]], [[acts 28 8|Act.28:8]].† (AS)
συν-ήδομαι to rejoice together; with dative, to rejoice with or in: τ. νόμῳ τ. θεοῦ, [[romans 7 22|Rom.7:22]] (see Lft., Notes, 304).† (AS)

συνήθεια, -ας, ἡ (ἦθος), [in LXX: 4Ma.2:12 4Mac 6:13 4Mac 13:22 4Mac 13:27 * ;] 1 1 intimacy. 2. habit, custom: [[john 18 39|Jhn.18:39]], [[1-corinthians 11 16|1Co.11:16]]; with genitive obj. (cf. Æschin., 23, 37, and see MM, xxiv), habitual use, force of habit with respect to, [[1-corinthians 8 7|1Co.8:7.]]† (AS)
συν-ηλικιώτης (ἡλικία), = συνῆλιζ (Æsch.), one of the same age, an equal in age: [[galatians 1 14|Gal.1:14.]]† (AS)
συν-θάπτω to bury together with: in symbolical sense, of baptism, σὐτῷ (with Christ), [[romans 6 4|Rom.6:4]], [[colossians 2 12|Col.2:12]].† (AS)
συν-θλάω, -ῶ [in LXX for מָחַץ etc. ;] to crush together, crush: [[matthew 21 44|Mat.21:44]] ([WH], R, mg., om.), [[luke 20 18|Luk.20:18.]]† (AS)
συν-θλίβω [in LXX: [[ecclesiastes 12 6|Ecc.12:6]] א A (רָצַץ), Sir.34:14 (31:14), 1Ma.15:14 A * ;] to press together, press on all sides: [[mark 5 24|Mrk.5:24, 31]].† (AS)
συν-θρύπτω to break in pieces, crush: metaphorically, τ. καρδίαν, [[acts 21 13|Act.21:13.]]† (AS)

συν-ίημι and συνίω (see Bl., § 23, 7), [in LXX chiefly for בִּין hi., שָׂכַל hi. ;] 1. to bring or set together. 2. Metaphorical, to perceive, understand: [[matthew 13 13|Mat.13:13-15]] (LXX), [[matthew 13 19|Mat.13:19 15:10]], [[mark 4 9|Mrk.4:9]] (WH, mg.), [[mark 4 12|Mrk.4:12 7:14 8:17, 21]] [[luke 8 10|Luk.8:10]], [[acts 7 25|Act.7:25 28:26-27]], [[romans 15 21|Rom.15:21]]" (LXX), [[2-corinthians 10 12|2Co.10:12;]] with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 13 23|Mat.13:23, 51]], [[luke 2 50|Luk.2:50 18:34 24:45]]; before ὅτι, [[matthew 16 12|Mat.16:12 17:13]]; before quæst. indir., [[ephesians 5 17|Eph.5:17;]] ἐπὶ τ. ἄρτοις, [[mark 6 52|Mrk.6:52;]] as subst., συνίων (ὁ σ., WH, mg.), a man of understanding, i.e. in moral and religious sense, [[romans 3 11|Rom.3:11]] (LXX).† (AS)

συν-ίστημι [in LXX for צָוָה pi., קָהַל ni., etc.; 1Ma.12:43, 2Ma.4:24, 3Ma.1:19 (and frequently in these books) ;] 1. trans., (a) to commend, recommend: with accusative of person(s), [[2-corinthians 3 1|2Co.3:1 6:4 10:12 10:18]]; id. with dative, [[romans 16 1|Rom.16:1]] (as frequently at the beginning of a letter; Deiss., LAE, 226), [[2-corinthians 5 12|2Co.5:12;]] before πρός, [[2-corinthians 4 2|2Co.4:2;]] pass., before ὑπό, [[2-corinthians 12 11|2Co.12:11;]] (b) to show, prove, establish: with accusative, [[romans 3 5|Rom.3:5 5:8]], [[2-corinthians 6 4|2Co.6:4]]; dupl. accusative, [[galatians 2 13|Gal.2:13;]] accusative and inf., [[2-corinthians 7 11|2Co.7:11]] 2. Intrans., pf., συνέστηκα (as also 2 aor. and plpf.); (a) to stand with or near: [[luke 9 32|Luk.9:32;]] (b) to be composed of, consist, cohere: [[colossians 1 17|Col.1:17]] (see Lft., in l), [[2-peter 3 5|2Pe.3:5.]]† (AS)
συν-οδεύω [in LXX: [[zechariah 8 21|Zec.8:21]] א1 (הָלַךְ), Tob.5:16 א, Wis.6:23 * ;] to journey with: with dative of person(s), [[acts 9 7|Act.9:7]] (Plut., al.).† (AS)
συνοδία, -ας, ἡ [in LXX: [[nehemiah 7 5|Neh.7:5, 64]] (יָחַשׂ) * ;] 1. a journey in company (Plut., al.). 2. By meton., κ company of travellers, a caravan: [[luke 2 44|Luk.2:44.]]† (AS)
συν-οικέω, -ῶ [in LXX for בַּעַל etc. ;] to dwell together: of man and wife (Hdt., al.), with dative of person(s), [[1-peter 3 7|1Pe.3:7]],† (AS)

συν-οίκοδομέω, -ῶ [in LXX: I [[esther 5 68|Est.5:68]] * ;] 1. to build together or with (with dative of person(s), 1Esdras, l.with). 2. Of various materials, to build up together (Thuc., al.): metaphorically, of Christians, [[ephesians 2 22|Eph.2:22.]]† (AS)
συν-ομιλέω, -ῶ to converse with (absol., FlJ, Bl, v, 13, 1; before μετά, Cebes, 13): with dative of person(s), [[acts 10 27|Act.10:27.]]† (AS)
συν-ομορέω, -ῶ to border on: with dative, [[acts 18 7|Act.18:7]] (Byz.).† (AS)

συν-οχή, -ῆς, ή (συνέχω), [in LXX: [[judges 2 3|Jdg.2:3]] (?), [[job 30 3|Job.30:3]] (שׁוֹא), [[job 38 28|Job.38:28]] A; [[micah 5 1|Mic.5:1]] (4:14), [[jeremiah 52 5|Jer.52:5]] (מָצוֹר) * ;] 1. a holding or being held together. 2. a narrow place (Hom., al.). Metaphorical, straits, distress: [[luke 21 25|Luk.21:25;]] καρδίας, [[2-corinthians 2 4|2Co.2:4.]]† (AS)
συν-τάσσω [in LXX chiefly for צָוָה pi. ;] to prescribe, ordain, arrange: with dative of person(s), [[matthew 21 6|Mat.21:6 26:19 27:10]]" (LXX) .† (AS)

συντέλεια, -ας, ἡ (συντελέω), [in LXX chiefly for כָּלָה and (in Da) for קוּם ;] 1. in cl., a joint payment or contribution for public service; hence, generally, joint action (Plat.). 2. In late writers (Polyb., al.), consummation, completion: σ. τ. αἰῶνος, -ων (cf. Dan LXX TH [[daniel 12 13|Dan.12:13]], al.), [[matthew 13 39|Mat.13:39-40, 49 24:3 28:20]], [[hebrews 9 26|Heb.9:26]].† (AS)

συν-τελέω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for כָּלָה pi., also for עָשָׂה, תָּמַם, etc. ;] "perfective" of τελέω (cf. M, Pr., 118), 1. to complete, finish, bring to an end: [[luke 4 13|Luk.4:13;]] pass., [[luke 4 2|Luk.4:2]], [[john 2 3|Jhn.2:3]], WH, mg., [[acts 21 27|Act.21:27.]] 2. to effect, accomplish, bring to fulfilment (cf. MM, xxiv): [[mark 13 4|Mrk.13:4]], [[romans 9 28|Rom.9:28]], [[hebrews 8 8|Heb.8:8]].† (AS)
συν-τέμνω [in LXX chiefly for חָרַץ ;] 1. to cut in pieces. 2. to cut down, cut short: metapb., λόγον, [[romans 9 28|Rom.9:28]] (LXX) (Hdt., Plat., Fur., al.).† (AS)

συν-τηρέω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[ezekiel 18 19|Eze.18:19]] (שָׁמַר), Da TH [[daniel 7 28|Dan.7:28]] A (נְטַר), Sir.13:12 and freq., Tob.1:11, 2Ma.12:42, al. ;] "perfective" of τηρέω (see M, Pr., 113, 116), to preserve, keep safe, keep close: with accusative of person(s), [[mark 6 20|Mrk.6:20;]] with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 9 17|Mat.9:17;]] ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ, [[luke 2 19|Luk.2:19]] (Arist. and later writers; cf. MM, xxiv).† (AS)

συν-τίθημι [in LXX: [[1-samuel 22 13|1Ki.22:13]] (קָשַׁר), etc. ;] to place or put together, in various senses. Mid., (a) to observe, perceive; (b) to determine, agree, covenant: with inf., [[luke 22 5|Luk.22:5;]] before τοῦ, with inf., [[acts 23 20|Act.23:20;]] before ἵνα, [[john 9 22|Jhn.9:22.]]† συν-επι-τίθημι, [in LXX for שִׁית, etc. ;] to help in putting on. Mid., to join in attacking (Thuc.): [[acts 24 9|Act.24:9]] (RV, joined in the charge).† (AS)
συν-τόμως, adv. (συντέμνω) [in LXX: [[proverbs 13 23|Pro.13:23 23:28]], 3Ma.5:25 * ;] concisely, briefly: [[acts 24 4|Act.24:4]] (for a similar ex., see MM, xxiv).† (AS)

συν-τρέχω [in LXX: [[psalms 50 18|Psa.50:18]] (עִם רָצָה), עִם רָצָה), 2Ma.2:1-32, Jdt.4.1-15 * ;] to run together or with: before ἐκεῖ, [[mark 6 33|Mrk.6:33;]] πρόσ, with accusative, [[acts 3 11|Act.3:11;]] metaphorically, [[1-peter 4 4|1Pe.4:4.]]† (AS)

συν-τρίβω [in LXX chiefly for שָׁבַר ;] to shatter, break in pieces: [[matthew 12 20|Mat.12:20]] (LXX), [[mark 5 4|Mrk.5:4 14:3]], [[john 19 36|Jhn.19:36]]" (LXX), [[revelation 2 27|Rev.2:27;]] of persons and parts of the body, to break, crush, bruise: [[luke 9 39|Luk.9:39;]] figuratively, [[romans 16 20|Rom.16:20.]]† (AS)

σύν-τριμμα, -τος, τό (συντρίβω), [in LXX ([[leviticus 21 19|Lev.21:19]], al.) chiefly for שֶׁבֶר; also for שֹׁד ([[isaiah 59 7|Isa.59:7]]), etc. ;] a fracture (Arist.; Le, l.with, al.). Metaphorical, calamity, destruction (Isa, l.with, Wis.3:3, al.): [[romans 3 16|Rom.3:16]]" (LXX) .† (AS)

σύν-τροφος, -ου, ὁ (συντρέφομαι, to be brought up together) [in LXX: 3Ki.12:24, 1Ma.1:6 R, 2Ma.9:29 * ;] 1. prop., one nourished or brought up with, a foster-brother: [[acts 13 1|Act.13:1]] EV. 2. In Hellenistic usage, as a court term, an intimate friend of a king (see Deiss., BS, 305, 310 f.): [[acts 13 1|Act.13:1]] (cf. also MM, xxiv).† (AS)
συν-τυγχάνω [in LXX: 2Ma.8:14 * ;] to meet with, fall in with: with dative of person(s), [[luke 8 19|Luk.8:19.]]† (AS)
Συντύχη (T, -τυχή), -ης, ἡ Syntyche: [[philippians 4 2|Php.4:2.]]† (AS)
συν-υπο-κρίνομαι to play a part with, dissemble with: with dative, [[galatians 2 13|Gal.2:13]] (Polyb.).† (AS)
συν-υπουργέω, -ῶ to help together, join in serving: with dative instr., [[2-corinthians 1 11|2Co.1:11.]]† (AS)
συν-ωδίνω to be in travail together (Arist.): metapb. (Eur.), [[romans 8 22|Rom.8:22.]]† (AS)
συνωμοσία, -ας, ή (συνόμνυμι, to conspire), [in Sm.: [[ezekiel 22 25|Eze.22:25]] * ;] a conspiracy: [[acts 23 13|Act.23:13.]]† (AS)
ionic Συρήκουσαι, doric Συράκοσαι, and Σῦράκοσσαι, Syracuse , (Herdotus Historicus), etc. (ML)
Σύρος, -ου, ὁ, fem. Σύρα a Syrian: [[luke 4 27|Luk.4:27]], [[mark 7 26|Mrk.7:26]], WH, mg.† (AS)
Συροφοινίκισσα (Rec. -φοίνισσα), -ης, ἡ a Syropænician woman: [[mark 7 26|Mrk.7:26]], WH, txt., RV (cf. ἡ Φοινίκη Συρία, Diod., 19, 93).† (AS)
Σύρτις (L, σῦρτις), -εως, accusative -ιν, ἡ, Syrtis, the name of two large sand-banks on the Libyan coast: [[acts 27 17|Act.27:17.]]† (AS)

σύρω [in LXX: [[2-kings 17 13|4Ki.17:13]] (סָחַב), 4Ma.6:1, al. ;] to draw, drag: with accusative of thing(s), [[john 21 8|Jhn.21:8]], [[revelation 12 4|Rev.12:4]]; with accusative of person(s), of taking to trial or punish­ment, [[acts 8 3|Act.8:3;]] ἔξω τ. πόλεως, [[acts 14 19|Act.14:19;]] ἐπὶ τ. πολιτάρχας (cf. 4Mac, l.with), [[acts 17 6|Act.17:6]] (cf. κατα-ούρω).† (AS)
συ-σπαράσσω to convulse completely: with accusative of person(s), [[mark 9 20|Mrk.9:20]], [[luke 9 42|Luk.9:42]] (cf. σπαράσσω).† (AS)

σύσ-σημον (T, συν-), -ου, τό (σῆμα), [in LXX: [[judges 20 38|Jdg.20:38, 40]] (מַשְׂאֵת), [[isaiah 5 26|Isa.5:26 49:22 62:10]] (נֵס) * ;] a fixed sign or signal: [[mark 14 44|Mrk.14:44.]] (Strab., Plut., al.; condemned by Atticists, see Rutherford, NPhr., 492 f.) † (AS)
σύν-σωμος (Rec. συσσ-), -ον (σῶμα), of the same body: [[ephesians 3 6|Eph.3:6]] (Eccl.).† (AS)

στασιαστής (στασιάζω, to stir up sedition, Jdth.7:15, 2Ma.4:30 2Mac 14:6 *) = Att.. στασιώτης, a rebel, revolutionist, one who stirs up sedition: [[mark 15 7|Mrk.15:7]] (FlJ, al.).† συ-στασιαστής, -οῦ, ὁ, a fellow-rioter: [[mark 15 7|Mrk.15:7]], Rec.† (AS)

συ-στατικός (Tr. συν-), -ή, -όν (συνίστημι), 1. for putting together, constructive. 2. for bringing together, introductory, commendatory: ἐπιστολή (Arist., Diog. L., al.; and see MM, xxiv), [[2-corinthians 3 1|2Co.3:1.]]† (AS)

συν-σταυρόω (Rec. συσ-), -ῶ, to crucify together with: pass., with dative, [[john 19 32|Jhn.19:32;]] id. before σύν, [[matthew 27 44|Mat.27:44]], [[mark 15 32|Mrk.15:32]]. Metaphorical, of the mystical death of the Christian with Christ: [[romans 6 6|Rom.6:6]], [[galatians 2 20|Gal.2:20]] (Eccl.).† (AS)

συν-στέλλω (Rec. συσ-), [in LXX: [[judges 8 28|Jdg.8:28 11:33]] (כָּנַע ni.), Sir.4:31, al. ;] 1. to draw together, contract, shorten: of time, [[1-corinthians 7 29|1Co.7:29.]] 2. to wrap up: of enshrouding a body for burial (Eur.), with accusative, [[acts 5 6|Act.5:6.]]† (AS)
συν-στενάζω (Rec. συσ-), to groan together or with: [[romans 8 22|Rom.8:22]] (with dative of person(s), Eur., Ion., 935).† (AS)
συν-στοιχέω (Rec. συσ-), -ῶ, to stand in the same rank or line (Polyb). Metaphorical, to correspond to: [[galatians 4 25|Gal.4:25]] (see Lft., in l).† (AS)
συν-στρατιώτης (Rec. συσ-), -ου, ὁ a fellow-soldier (Plat., Xen., al.). Metaphorical, of fellowship in Christian service: [[philippians 2 25|Php.2:25]], Phm 2 .† (AS)

συ-στέφω [in LXX chiefly for קָשַׁר ;] 1. to twist together: with accusative of thing(s), [[acts 28 3|Act.28:3.]] 2. Pass., of persons, to gather themselves together: [[matthew 17 22|Mat.17:22]] (WH, R, mg.).† (AS)

συ-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ (συστρέφω), [in LXX: [[romans 4 19|Rom.4:19 13:12]] (צָרַר); σ. ποιεῖσθαι, [[amos 7 10|Amo.7:10]] (קָשַׁר), etc. ;] 1. a twisting together (Plat.). 2. a concourse, a riotous gathering (Polyb.): [[acts 19 40|Act.19:40;]] σ. ποιεῖσθαι (Am, l.with), to make a compact (RV, banded themselves together): [[acts 23 12|Act.23:12.]]† (AS)
συν-σχηματιζω (Rec. συσ-), (σχῆμα), to conform to (Arist.). Pass., to be conformed to, conform oneself to: [[romans 12 2|Rom.12:2]], [[1-peter 1 14|1Pe.1:14]].† (AS)
Συχάρ (Ε, Σιχάρ), indecl., ἡ Sychar, a town of Samaria: [[john 4 5|Jhn.4:5.]]† (AS)

Συχέμ indecl. (Heb. שְׁכֶם), Shechem; 1. the son of Hamor ([[genesis 33 19|Gen.33:19]]): [[acts 7 16|Act.7:16]] b, Rec. 2. A city of Samaria (AV, Sychem; in LXX also sometimes Σίκιμα, -ων, as in FlJ): [[acts 7 16|Act.7:16]] a,b.† (AS)
σφαγή, -ῆς, ἡ (σφάζω), [in LXX for טָבַח, הֲרֵגָה, etc. ;] slaughter: [[acts 8 32|Act.8:32]] (LXX); πρόβατα σφαγῆς, [[romans 8 36|Rom.8:36]] (LXX); ἡμέρα σφαγῆς, [[james 5 5|Jas.5:5.]]† (AS)

σφάγιον, -ου, τό (σφαγή), [in LXX: [[amos 5 25|Amo.5:25]] (זֶבַח), [[ezekiel 21 10|Eze.21:10, 15 21:28]] (טֶבַח), [[leviticus 22 23|Lev.22:23]] (נְדָבָה) * ;] a victim for slaughter: [[acts 7 42|Act.7:42]] (LXX).† (AS)

σφάζω [in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַט ;] to slay, slaughter (esp. of victims for sacrifice): ἀρνίον, [[revelation 5 6|Rev.5:6, 12 13:8]]; of persons, [[1-john 3 12|1Jn.3:12]], [[revelation 5 9|Rev.5:9 6:4, 9 18:24]]; ἐσφαγμένη εἰς θάνατον (RV, smitten unto death), [[revelation 13 3|Rev.13:3]] (cf. κατα-σφάζω).† (AS)

σφόδρα adv. (prop. neut. of σφοδρός, excessive, violent) [in LXX chiefly for מְאֹד ;] very, very much, exceedingly: with verbs, [[matthew 17 6|Mat.17:6, 23 18:31 19:25 26:22 27:54]], [[acts 6 7|Act.6:7]]; with adjectives, [[matthew 2 10|Mat.2:10]], [[mark 16 4|Mrk.16:4]], [[luke 18 23|Luk.18:23]], [[revelation 16 21|Rev.16:21]].† (AS)
σφοδρῶς adv., exceedingly: [[acts 27 18|Act.27:18.]]† (AS)

σφραγίζω [in LXX chiefly for חָתַם ([[deuteronomy 32 34|Deu.32:34]], al.), also for סָתַם (Da TH [[daniel 8 26|Dan.8:26]]) ;] to seal, (a) for security: [[matthew 27 66|Mat.27:66]], [[revelation 20 3|Rev.20:3]]; τ. καρπὸν τοῦτον, figuratively (cf. Deiss., BS, 238 f.; MM, xxiv; DB, iv, 427a), [[romans 15 28|Rom.15:28;]] (b) for concealment, hence, metaphorically, to hide (Da TH [[daniel 9 24|Dan.9:24]], [[john 14 17|Jhn.14:17]]): [[revelation 10 4|Rev.10:4 22:10]]; (with) for distinction, [[revelation 7 3|Rev.7:3-8;]] metaphorically, [[ephesians 4 30|Eph.4:30;]] mid., [[2-corinthians 1 22|2Co.1:22;]] (d) for authentication ([[esther 8 8|Est.8:8]]): [[john 3 33|Jhn.3:33 6:27]] (cf. κατα-σφραγίζω).† (AS)

σφραγίς, -ῖδος, ἡ [in LXX: [[exodus 28 11|Exo.28:11]], al. (חוֹתָם) [[exodus 35 22|Exo.35:22]] (חָח), Sir.17:22, al. ;] 1. a seal, signet: [[revelation 7 2|Rev.7:2.]] 2. The impression of a seal or signet, a seal (on its various purposes, see: σφραγίζω): on a book or roll, [[revelation 5 1|Rev.5:1-2, 5 5:9 6:1, 3 6:5, 7 6:9, 12 8:1]]; metaphorically, [[romans 4 11|Rom.4:11]], [[1-corinthians 9 2|1Co.9:2]], [[2-timothy 2 19|2Ti.2:19]], [[revelation 9 4|Rev.9:4]].† (AS)
σφυρόν, -οῦ, τό, [in LXX: [[job 41 21|Job.41:21]] (לָהַט) * ;] the ankle: [[acts 3 7|Act.3:7]], Rec. (T, WH, σφυδρόν; see Bl., § 6, 8).† (AS)
σχέδον adv. (ἔχω), [in LXX: 2Ma.5:2, 3Ma.5:14 3Mac 5:45 * ;] 1. of place, near. 2. Of degree, almost, nearly: [[acts 13 44|Act.13:44 19:26]], [[hebrews 9 22|Heb.9:22]].† (AS)
σχῆμα, -τος, τό (ἔχω), [in LXX: [[isaiah 3 17|Isa.3:17]] (פֹּת) * ;] figure, fashion: [[1-corinthians 7 31|1Co.7:31]], [[philippians 2 8|Php.2:8]].† SYN.: see: μορφή (AS)

σχίζω [in LXX chiefly for בָּקַע ;] to cleave, rend: [[matthew 27 51|Mat.27:51]], [[mark 1 10|Mrk.1:10 15:38]], [[luke 5 36|Luk.5:36 23:45]], [[john 19 24|Jhn.19:24 21:11]]; metaphorically, in pass., to be divided into factions, [[acts 14 4|Act.14:4 23:7]].† (AS)

σχίσμα, -τος, τό (σχίζω), a rent (Arist., al.): [[matthew 9 16|Mat.9:16]], [[mark 2 21|Mrk.2:21]]. Metaphorical, a dissension, division: [[john 7 43|Jhn.7:43 9:16 10:19]], [[1-corinthians 1 10|1Co.1:10 11:18 12:25]].† SYN.: see: αἵρεσις (AS)
σχοινίον, -ου, τό (dimin. of σχοῖνος, a rush), [in LXX chiefly for a rope (prop., one made of rushes): [[john 2 15|Jhn.2:15]], [[acts 27 32|Act.27:32]].† (AS)

σχολάζω (σχολή), [in LXX: [[exodus 5 8|Exo.5:8, 17]], [[psalms 46 10|Psa.46:10]] (רָפָה ni., hi.) * ;] to be at leisure, hence, to have time or opportunity for, to devote oneself to, be occupied in: [[1-corinthians 7 5|1Co.7:5;]] of things, to be unoccupied, empty (Plut., Eur., al.): οἶκος, [[matthew 12 44|Mat.12:44]], [[luke 11 25|Luk.11:25]] (T [WH], R, om.).† (AS)

σχολή, -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX: [[genesis 33 14|Gen.33:14]] (κατὰ σ., אַט), [[proverbs 28 19|Pro.28:19]], Sir.38:24 * ;] 1. leisure. 2. Later (from Plato on), (a) that for which leisure is employed, a disputation, lecture; (b) the place where lectures are delivered, a school: [[acts 19 9|Act.19:9]] (for the later sense of employment, see MM, xxiv).† (AS)

σώζω (on the more accurate σῴζω, see WH, Intr., §410; Bl., §3, 1-3), [in LXX chiefly for ישׁע hi., also for מלט ni., נצל ni., etc. ;] to save from peril, injury or suffering: [[matthew 8 25|Mat.8:25]], [[mark 13 20|Mrk.13:20]], [[luke 23 35|Luk.23:35]], al.; τ. ψυχήν, [[matthew 16 25|Mat.16:25]], al.; before ἐκ, [[john 12 27|Jhn.12:27]], [[hebrews 5 7|Heb.5:7]], Ju 5; of healing, restoring to health: [[matthew 9 22|Mat.9:22]], [[mark 5 34|Mrk.5:34]], al. In NT, esp. of salvation from spiritual disease and death, in which sense it is "spoken of in Scripture as either (1) past, (2) present, or (3) future, according as redemption, grace, or glory is the point in view. Thus (1) [[romans 8 24|Rom.8:24]], [[ephesians 2 5|Eph.2:5]], 8 [[2-timothy 1 9|2Ti.1:9]], [[titus 3 5|Tit.3:5]]; (2) [[acts 2 47|Act.2:47]], 1Co.1:18, 15:2, [[2-corinthians 2 15|2Co.2:15]]; (3) [[matthew 10 22|Mat.10:22]], [[romans 13 11|Rom.13:11]], [[philippians 2 12|Php.2:12]], [[hebrews 9 28|Heb.9:28]]" (Vau. on [[romans 5 9|Rom.5:9]]). Seq. ἀπό, [[matthew 1 21|Mat.1:21]], [[acts 2 40|Act.2:40]], [[romans 5 9|Rom.5:9]]; ἐκ, [[james 5 20|Jas.5:20]], Ju 23 (cf. Cremer, 532ff.). (AS)

σῶμα, -τος, τό, [in LXX for גְּוִיָּה ,בָּשָׂר, etc., and for Aram. נְבֵלָה ;] a body. 1. Prop., of the human body, (a) as always in Hom. (opposite to δέμας), of the dead body: [[matthew 27 58|Mat.27:58, 59]] [[mark 15 43|Mrk.15:43]], al.; (b) of the living body: [[luke 11 34|Luk.11:34]], [[1-corinthians 6 13|1Co.6:13]], al.; ἐν σ. εἶναι, [[hebrews 13 3|Heb.13:3;]] as the instrument of the soul, τὰ διὰ τοῦ σ., [[2-corinthians 5 10|2Co.5:10;]] opposite to πνεῦμα, [[romans 8 10|Rom.8:10]], [[1-corinthians 5 3|1Co.5:3 7:4]], [[james 2 26|Jas.2:26]]; to ψυχή, [[matthew 6 25|Mat.6:25 10:28]], [[luke 12 22|Luk.12:22]] (cf. Wis.1:1, al.); to τὸ π. καὶ ἡ ψ., [[1-thessalonians 5 23|1Th.5:23;]] σ. ψυχικόν, opposite to σ. πνευματικόν, [[1-corinthians 15 44|1Co.15:44;]] ὁ ναὸς τοῦ σ. αὐτοῦ (genitive epexeg.), [[john 2 21|Jhn.2:21;]] τὸ σ. τ. ταπεινώσεως (Hebraistic "genitive of definition"; M, Pr., 73f.; Bl., §35, 5), opposite to τὸ σ. τ. δοξῆς αὐτοῦ, [[philippians 3 21|Php.3:21;]] similarly, τὸ σ. τ. σαρκός, [[colossians 1 22|Col.1:22;]] σ. τοῦ θανάτου (subject to death), [[romans 7 24|Rom.7:24;]] σ. τ. ἁμαρτίας, [[romans 6 6|Rom.6:6;]] (with) periphr., ἀνθρώπου, then absol., σῶμα (Soph., Xen., al.), a person, and in later writers (Polyb., al.), a slave: [[revelation 18 13|Rev.18:13]] (cf. MM, i, ii, xxiv; Deiss., BS, 160). 2. Of the bodies of animals: living, [[james 3 3|Jas.3:3;]] dead, [[hebrews 13 11|Heb.13:11]] ( [[exodus 29 14|Exo.29:14]], al.). 3. Of inanimate objects (cf. Eng. "heavenly bodies"): [[1-corinthians 15 37|1Co.15:37, 38 40]] (Diod., al.). 4. Of any corporeal substance (Plat., al.): opposite to σκιά, [[colossians 2 17|Col.2:17.]] Metaphorical, of a number of persons united by a common bond; in NT, of the Church as the spiritual body of Christ: [[romans 12 5|Rom.12:5]], [[1-corinthians 10 16|1Co.10:16, 17 12:13, 27]], [[ephesians 1 23|Eph.1:23 2:16 4:4, 12, 16 5:23, 30]], [[colossians 1 18|Col.1:18, 24 2:19 3:15]]; ἓν σ. κ. ἓν πνεῦμα, [[ephesians 4 4|Eph.4:4.]] (AS)

σωματικός, -ή, -όν (σῶμα), [in LXX: 4Ma.1:32 4Mac 3:1 * ;] (a) of or for the body, bodily: γυμνασία, [[1-timothy 4 8|1Ti.4:8;]] (b) (opposite to ἀσώματος) bodily, corporeal: εἶδος, [[luke 3 22|Luk.3:22.]]† (AS)
σωματικῶς adv., bodily, corporeally: [[colossians 2 9|Col.2:9]] (see ICC, Lft., in l).† (AS)
Σώπατρος, -ου, ὁ Sopater: [[acts 20 4|Act.20:4.]]† (AS)

σωρεύω [in LXX: [[proverbs 25 22|Pro.25:22]] (חָתָה), Jdth.15:11 * ;] (a) to heap on: with accusative before ἐπί with accusative, [[romans 12 20|Rom.12:20]] (LXX) (Arist., al.); (b) to heap with: with accusative and dative, metaphorically, ἁμαρτίαις, [[2-timothy 3 6|2Ti.3:6]] (overwhelmed with, Field, Notes, 217) (Polyb.).† (AS)
Σωσθένης, -ου, ὁ Sosthenes; (a) a Jewish ruler: [[acts 18 7|Act.18:7;]] (b) a Christian: [[1-corinthians 1 1|1Co.1:1.]]† (AS)
Σωσίπατρος, -ου, ὁ Sosipater: [[romans 16 21|Rom.16:21.]]† (AS)

σωτήρ, -ῆρος, ὁ (σώζω), [in LXX for יָשַׁע and cognate forms ;] saviour, deliverer, preserver, a frequently epithet of kings in the Ptolemaic and Rom. periods (Deiss., BS, 83; LAE, 368 f.; MM, xxiv), in NT, (a) of God (as LXX: [[psalms 24 5|Psa.24:5]], [[isaiah 12 2|Isa.12:2]], al.): [[luke 1 47|Luk.1:47]], [[1-timothy 1 1|1Ti.1:1 2:3 4:10]], [[titus 1 3|Tit.1:3 2:10 3:4]], Ju 25; (b) of Christ: [[luke 2 11|Luk.2:11]], [[acts 5 31|Act.5:31 13:23]], [[philippians 3 20|Php.3:20]]; τ. κόσμου, [[john 4 42|Jhn.4:42]], [[1-john 4 14|1Jn.4:14]] (for the general use of the word, see Westc., in l); ἡμῶν, [[2-timothy 1 10|2Ti.1:10]], [[titus 1 4|Tit.1:4 3:6]]; θεὸς (κύριος) καὶ σ. (see Deiss., LAE, 348.4; M, Pr., 84), [[titus 2 13|Tit.2:13]], [[2-peter 1 1|2Pe.1:1 1:11 2:20 3:2 3:18]]; σ. τοῦ σώματος (i.e. of the Church; see: σῶμα, 5), [[ephesians 5 23|Eph.5:23.]]† (AS)

σωτηρία, -ας, ἡ (σωτήρ), [in LXX for יֶשַׁע, יְשׁוּעָה, תְּשׁוּעָה, פְּלֵיטָה, etc. ;] deliverance, preservation, salvation, safety (Lat. salus): [[acts 7 25|Act.7:25 27:34]], [[hebrews 11 7|Heb.11:7]]; ἐξ ἐχθρῶν, [[luke 1 71|Luk.1:71.]] In NT esp. of Messianic and spiritual salvation (see: σώζω): [[luke 19 9|Luk.19:9]], [[john 4 22|Jhn.4:22]], [[acts 4 12|Act.4:12 13:47]], [[romans 11 11|Rom.11:11]], [[2-thessalonians 2 13|2Th.2:13]], [[2-timothy 3 15|2Ti.3:15]], [[hebrews 2 3|Heb.2:3 6:9]], [[2-peter 3 15|2Pe.3:15]], Ju 3; opposite to ἀπηώλεια, [[philippians 1 28|Php.1:28;]] αἰώνιος-., [[hebrews 5 9|Heb.5:9;]] ὁ λόγος (τὸ εὐαγγέλιον) τῆς σ., [[acts 13 26|Act.13:26]], [[ephesians 1 13|Eph.1:13]]; ὁδὸς σωτηρίας, [[acts 16 17|Act.16:17;]] κέρας σωτηρίας, [[luke 1 69|Luk.1:69;]] ἡμέρα σωτηρίας, [[2-corinthians 6 2|2Co.6:2]] (LXX); κατεργάζεσθαι τὴν ἑαυτοῦ σ., [[philippians 2 12|Php.2:12;]] κληρονομεῖν σ., [[hebrews 1 14|Heb.1:14;]] ὁ ἀρχηγὸς τῆς σ., [[hebrews 2 10|Heb.2:10;]] εἰς σ., [[romans 1 16|Rom.1:16 10:1, 10]], [[1-peter 2 2|1Pe.2:2]]; σ. as a present possession (see: σώζω), [[luke 1 77|Luk.1:77]], [[2-corinthians 1 6|2Co.1:6 7:10]], [[philippians 1 19|Php.1:19]], [[2-timothy 2 10|2Ti.2:10]]; as more fully realized in the future: [[romans 13 11|Rom.13:11]], [[1-thessalonians 5 8|1Th.5:8-9]], [[hebrews 9 28|Heb.9:28]], [[1-peter 1 5|1Pe.1:5 1:9-10]], [[revelation 7 10|Rev.7:10 12:10 19:1]].† (AS)

σωτήριος, -ον (σωτήρ), [in LXX for יְשׁוּעָה, שֶׁלֶם, etc. ;] saving, bringing salvation, in NT always in spiritual sense (see: σώζω, σωτηρία): ἡ χάρις ἡ σ., [[titus 2 1|Tit.2:1.]] Neut., -τὸ σ., as subst. (cl.), salvation: [[luke 2 30|Luk.2:30;]] τ. σ. τ. θεοῦ, [[luke 3 6|Luk.3:6]], [[acts 28 28|Act.28:28]]; περικεφαλαίαν τοῦ σ., [[ephesians 6 17|Eph.6:17.]]† (AS)

σωφρονέω, -ῶ (σώφρων), (a) to be of sound mind or in one's right mind: [[mark 5 15|Mrk.5:15]], [[luke 8 35|Luk.8:35]]; opposite to ἐκστῆναι, [[2-corinthians 5 13|2Co.5:13]] (Hdt.); (b) to be temperate, discreet, self-controlled (opposite to μαίνεσθαι, ὑβρίζειν, etc.; sch., Thuc., al.): [[titus 2 6|Tit.2:6;]] opposite to ὑπερφρονεῖν, [[romans 12 3|Rom.12:3;]] σ. καὶ νήφειν, [[1-peter 4 7|1Pe.4:7.]]† (AS)
σωφρονίζω [in Aq.: [[isaiah 38 16|Isa.38:16]] * ;] to make σώφρων, recall one to his senses, control (RV, train): with accusative of person(s), [[titus 2 4|Tit.2:4.]]† (AS)
σωφρονισμός, -οῦ, ὁ (σωφρονίζω), (a) an admonishing (F1J, Plut., al.); (b) self-control, self-discipline: [[2-timothy 1 7|2Ti.1:7]] (on the reflexive meaning here, see Ellic., in l).† (AS)
σωφρόνως adv., [in LXX: Wis.9:11 * ;] with sound mind, prudently, soberly: [[titus 2 12|Tit.2:12.]]† (AS)

σωφροσύνη, -ης, ἡ [in LXX: [[esther 3 13|Est.3:13]], Wis.8:7, 2Ma.4:37, 4Ma.6:1-35 * ;] (a) soundness of mind, good sense, sanity (opposite to μανία, Xen.): [[acts 26 25|Act.26:25;]] (b) self-control, sobriety: [[1-timothy 2 9|1Ti.2:9]] (see Tr., Syn., § xx), [[1-timothy 2 15|1Ti.2:15.]]† (AS)
σώφρων, -ον [in LXX: 4Ma.9:1-32 * ;] (a) of sound mind, sane, sensible; (b) self-controlled, sober-minded: [[1-timothy 3 2|1Ti.3:2]], [[titus 1 8|Tit.1:8 2:2, 5]] (Arist.).† (AS)
ταβέρνη (Lat. taberna), see: Τρεῖς Ταβέρναι. Τρεῖς Ταβέρναι (see: ταβέρνη), Three Taverns (Lit. Tres Tabernae) a halting place on the Appian Way: [[acts 28 15|Act.28:15]] (see DB, iv, 690).† (AS)
